name: WishCraft
tagline: Make a personal card for anyone, in any language: heartfelt words, original art, a voice note and a little song.
description:
WishCraft turns a few details about someone you care about into a card that feels made just for them.

Pick the occasion (birthday, anniversary, thank you, get well, a festival, or anything else), tell WishCraft who it is for and one or two things you love about them. In about a minute you get:

- A personal message in the language and tone you choose (25 languages)
- Original card art painted in the style you pick
- A voice note that reads your message aloud in a voice that speaks the language
- A song with their name in the lyrics, long enough to sing every line

Cards are lettered by hand or in print with typefaces made for each script, so Hindi, Chinese or Arabic cards look as natural as English ones. Edit the words, change the lettering or repaint the art, then download (card as JPG, audio as MP3, or everything as a ZIP) or share. Every card is saved in My cards. If you close WishCraft halfway through, it picks up where you left off.

The cost is shown before you create anything. A card with art and a voice note uses about 5 to 11 Anna credits; a song adds about 10 to 34, depending on the language.
